verdict.rationale: Databricks publishes a first-party REST API reference covering types, paths, request payloads and query parameters for each supported operation, often with request/response examples. It also documents versioned APIs with migration guidance and exposes governed objects through REST APIs, alongside an SDK for automating operations. The probe found no machine-readable OpenAPI spec at the standard paths, and no hands-on API usage is corroborated. missing for 10: a discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec, independent hands-on corroboration of driving the platform via the API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: This reference contains information about the Databricks workspace-level application programming interfaces (APIs).

This reference describes the types, paths, and any request payload or query parameters, for each supported Databricks REST API operation. Many reference pages also provide request and response payload examples.
You work with the objects Unity Catalog governs through Catalog Explorer, SQL, the Databricks CLI, and REST APIs.
you learn how to automate Databricks operations and accelerate development with the Databricks SDK for Python
